theorem.observational_equivalence: w ~_Q w' IFF q(w)=q(w') FOR EVERY ADMISSIBLE QUERY q IN Q.
theorem.unsplittable_lower_bound: NO ADAPTIVE QUERY STRATEGY USING ONLY Q CAN DISTINGUISH TWO WORLDS IN THE SAME ~_Q CLASS.
theorem.cell_policy_cover: FOR ANY CURRENT INDISTINGUISHABILITY CELL C LET tau(C) BE THE MINIMUM NUMBER OF BRAIN-OWNED POLICIES WHOSE ADEQUACY SETS COVER C.
theorem.meaning: R_b(C) IS THE EXACT MINIMUM NUMBER OF EXTRA PERSISTENT/SEMANTIC MESSAGE STATES NEEDED AFTER THE BEST ADAPTIVE QUERY TREE OF DEPTH AT MOST b IN THE DECLARED FINITE MODEL.
theorem.unlimited_finite_query_limit: AFTER ALL ADMISSIBLE FINITE QUERIES, R_* = MAX_OVER_OBSERVATIONAL_EQUIVALENCE_CLASSES_E tau(E).
theorem.zero_residual_criterion: ZERO EXTRA SEMANTIC INFORMATION IS NECESSARY IFF EVERY UNSPLITTABLE OBSERVATIONAL EQUIVALENCE CLASS HAS AT LEAST ONE COMMON TERMINALLY ADEQUATE BRAIN-OWNED POLICY.
proof_sketch: LOWER BOUND: INSIDE ONE QUERY-EQUIVALENCE CLASS EVERY ADMISSIBLE QUERY HAS IDENTICAL OBSERVATION, SO THE DECODER CANNOT CONDITION ON QUERY RESULTS TO SEPARATE ITS WORLDS. ANY EXTRA MESSAGE STATE CAN SELECT AT MOST ONE POLICY FOR THAT CLASS, HENCE AT LEAST tau(E) STATES ARE REQUIRED.
UPPER BOUND: QUERY EVERY DISTINGUISHING QUERY NEEDED TO IDENTIFY THE FINAL EQUIVALENCE CLASS; WITHIN THAT CLASS USE A MINIMUM ADEQUATE POLICY COVER AND REUSE MESSAGE LABELS ACROSS CLASSES.

FINITE-BUDGET RECURRENCE: EACH QUERY PARTITIONS THE CURRENT CELL; WORST-BRANCH RESIDUAL STATES DETERMINE GUARANTEED SUFFICIENCY, AND MINIMIZATION OVER AVAILABLE QUERIES GIVES THE OPTIMAL ADAPTIVE TREE.

five_role_consequence.rule: B0 B1 B2 B4 B7 DO NOT REQUIRE SEPARATE GENERIC SEMANTIC MECHANISMS. FOR EACH SURVIVING CONTEXT, THE LOAD-BEARING QUESTION IS WHETHER ADMISSIBLE OBSERVATIONS/VERIFIERS SPLIT THE WORLD ENOUGH THAT EACH FINAL CELL HAS A COMMON ADEQUATE OWNED POLICY.
five_role_consequence.irreducible_residual: ONLY UNSPLITTABLE OR BUDGET-UNSPLIT CONTEXT CELLS WITH tau>1 REQUIRE ADDITIONAL SEMANTIC INFORMATION, A STRONGER QUERY/VERIFIER, OR A NEW POLICY/MECHANISM.
scheduler: FIRST SEARCH FOR A POSITIVE ADEQUATE OWNED POLICY COVER.
THEN SEARCH FOR THE CHEAPEST ADMISSIBLE QUERY THAT REDUCES THE WORST-BRANCH POLICY-COVER NUMBER.
STOP AS SOON AS R_b=1 FOR THE LOAD-BEARING DEADLINE/QUERY BUDGET.
ONLY IF R_b>1 AFTER THE COMPLETE ADMISSIBLE QUERY MODEL IS BOUND MAY THE REMAINING LOG2(R_b) INFORMATION BE CALLED IRREDUCIBLE FOR THAT FINITE MODEL.
DO NOT INFER OPEN-WORLD IRREDUCIBILITY FROM A PARTIAL QUERY SET.

relation_to_v9.positive_result: V9 DEMONSTRATES A FROZEN H-BLIND ACTIVE-QUERY KERNEL CAN DRIVE R_b TO 1 ON 12/12 FRESH FINITE TYPED TARGETS WITH MAX 3 QUERIES AND ZERO CAMPAIGN-TIME PERSISTENT CAPABILITY GROWTH.
relation_to_v9.what_it_does_not_prove: V9 DOES NOT PROVE THE REAL OPUS55 SEMANTIC WORLD/POLICY/QUERY UNIVERSE IS FINITE PREENCODED COMPLETE OR THAT ALL REAL UNSPLITTABLE CLASSES HAVE tau=1.
relation_to_v9.correct_use: USE V9 AS A CONSTRUCTIVE EXISTENCE WITNESS FOR THE QUERY-ACQUISITION ROUTE WHEN A REAL TERMINAL CONTEXT IS SOUNDLY REDUCED TO A COMPATIBLE FINITE TYPED MODEL.

A CLAIMED ZERO-RESIDUAL CLASS HAS NO COMMON TERMINALLY ADEQUATE OWNED POLICY.
THE ADEQUACY WITNESSES USED IN tau(C) ARE UNSOUND OR THE POLICY UNIVERSE IS NOT BRAIN-OWNED.
THE QUERY BUDGET OR DEADLINE MAKES THE REQUIRED OPTIMAL TREE INADMISSIBLE.
